messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads up team: AuroraHealth POC request. Requirements: process+store only in UK (europe-west2) and Canada (northamerica-northeast1). BYOK mandatory. They want a definitive subprocessor roster, confirmation we can prevent any data/control-plane egress to US, and a POC cost+timeline. Can presales/infra/legal advise? @Priya @Marco @Aisha

Priya (Presales): We can support via Dedicated-regional or Private. Hosted public API cannot guarantee zero-control-plane signaling to our central control plane (US) unless we enable our regional control-plane feature. Need to confirm if control-plane must be in-region or just data-plane. Also confirm if audit logs must stay in-region or can be routed to customer's SIEM (we can do in-region forwarding).

Marco (Infra): Quick bullets:
- Data-plane pinning: yes (we can pin inference + storage to europe-west2 and northamerica-northeast1).
- Control-plane: can run regional control-plane (hosted add-on) to avoid US egress; this is a one-off infra deploy per region.
- BYOK: supported, HSM partner can be provisioned in-region; customer can import keys.
- Non-negotiable caveats: OCSP/CRL for public CA checks and some OS/package repo pulls during provisioning may reach external endpoints. We can mirror OCSP responses or run a local CA proxy (adds ~3-5 business days).
- Audit log/SIEM: we can ship logs directly to customer's in-region SIEM or keep logs in-region for retention.

Aisha (Legal): Subprocessors: cloud infra (GCP in europe-west2 / northamerica-northeast1), KMS/HSM partner (regional estate), monitoring vendor (we offer EU/CA tenancy), incident response vendor (can be configured regionally), and support platform (PagerDuty/ops tooling). I will prepare a formal subprocessor attestation. If Aurora requires absolute no-third-country transfers we must document exceptions (OCSP, time NTP, package repos) and request signed risk acceptance or implement mitigations.

Devon (AE): Price/time ask from procurement: what's a realistic 6-week POC cost and how fast can we stand this up if SOW signed this week? They also asked about latency SLA for europe-west2 -> customer app.

Priya (Presales): Ballpark POC pricing: Dedicated-regional (small) + BYOK + ops on-call = $9,500/month. Regional control-plane add-on: one-time ~$3,500 per region. If Private/VPC: one-time integration $9k + $5k/month licensing. So a 6-week POC range: $8k-$16k depending on options. Latency SLA: we can commit to 200ms p95 within same region for small-scale POC; need SLA language for production.

Marco (Infra): Config snippet to forward to customer:
```yaml
deployment_mode: dedicated-regional
regions:
  - europe-west2
  - northamerica-northeast1
control_plane: regional-addon
byok: true
hsm_partner: regional
audit_log_forwarding: customer-siem-endpoint
ocsp_mitigation: local-proxy-optional
egress_policy: deny-third-country
fallback_policy: fail-open-manual-approval
```
Notes: fallback_policy default is fail-open for some infra health checks; set to manual to prevent any automatic failover that might route through another region. Enabling strict manual-failover + regional control-plane gives closest to "no-US egress" behavior.

Aisha (Legal): I'll draft the DPA addendum + subprocessor attestation and include the required risk acceptance clause for OCSP/time-sync unless they request/procure the local CA proxy option.

Marco (Infra): Action items: I'll produce a region-scoped subproc export + an egress diagram showing potential non-data egress points (OCSP, package repos, time sync) within 48 hours. Also note: regional capacity has ~12% cost uplift over global pooling and control-plane per-region provisioning takes ~3-5 days/region.

Devon (AE): Timeline: if SOW signed this week and customer supplies keys/certs promptly, we can target POC start in 14-21 calendar days (BYOK import + regional control-plane + smoke tests).

Sam (Sales): Thanks — I'll send the config snippet + ballpark and ask them to sign the OCSP/time-sync risk acceptance or opt for local proxy. Looping in procurement.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-9350 created for AuroraHealth subproc export + egress diagram; assigned to Marco.
